author: manuarora700
name: canvas-reveal-effect
description:
A dot background that expands on hover, as seen on Clerk's website

Features:
-  Animated Reveal: Smooth animations grab users' attention as content pops up.  
-  Customizable Speed: Tweak the animation speed to match the vibe you want.  
-  Color and Opacity Control: Play around with colors and opacities for cool visual effects.  
-  Dot Matrix Effect: Add a modern, techy look with a dot matrix pattern.  
-  Gradient Overlay: Use an optional gradient overlay for extra visual depth.  
-  Responsive Design: Fits perfectly on any screen size for a consistent experience.  

Example Use Cases:  
-  Call to Action on Landing Page: Use fun animations to highlight important actions or offers.  
-  Cards on Landing Page: Make card displays pop with dynamic reveal effects to showcase key info.
